name: sp_400_Normalized

schema.description: Context Schema for a youtube player event

autoPlay.description: This specifies whether the initial video will automatically start to play when the player loads.

avaliablePlaybackRates.description: An array of playback rates in which the current video is available

avaliableQualityLevels.description: An array of quality levels in which the current video is available

controls.description: Whether the video player controls are displayed

error.description: A string of the latest error to occur, or null if no errors

fov.description: The field-of-view of the view in degrees, as measured along the longer edge of the viewport

loaded.description: The percentage of the video that the player shows as buffered

origin.description: The origin domain of the embed

pitch.description: The vertical angle of the view in degrees

playbackQuality.description: The quality level of the current video

playerId.description: The HTML id of the video element

playlist.description: An array of the video IDs in the playlist as they are currently ordered.

playlistIndex.description: The index of the playlist video that is currently playing

roll.description: The clockwise or counterclockwise rotational angle of the view in degrees

url.description: The YouTube embed URL of the media resource

yaw.description: The horizontal angle of the view in degrees

description:
The YouTube embed located at https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ?rel=0 (origin https://www.example.com) is rendered in a player whose HTML id is **player123**. autoplay is disabled, controls are visible, and the video is not cued or unstarted; it is currently playing (not buffering) with 75 % of the content buffered. The view is set to a field‑of‑view of 90° with a pitch of 5°, a yaw of 45°, and a roll of 0°, giving a horizontal angle of 45° and a vertical angle of 5°. The playback quality in use is **hd1080**, and the player supports the quality levels hd1080, hd720 and large, as well as playback rates of 0.5×, 1×, 1.5× and 2×.  

The current playlist contains two videos – “dQw4w9WgXcQ” and “eY52Zsg-KVI” – with the first entry (index 0) now playing. No error has been resolved, and the latest reported error code is **NOT_FOUND**. The player is configured to show its controls, and all settings fall within the allowed ranges (e.g., yaw ≤ 360°, roll between ‑180° and 180°, pitch between ‑90° and 90°).
